selection_source: v0.6 PICMUS contrast/resolution phantom sweep; no retuning here
scope: Five acquisitions excluded from the aperture sweep, but already inspected in earlier project stages. This is a frozen-parameter transfer check, not a new blinded or clinical validation. No population generalization; defaults remain unchanged.
reference_policy: PICMUS: embedded UFF image, algorithmic reference not anatomical ground truth. EPFL/Alpinion: no independent reference; aperture-change similarity only describes how much the output changed and is not a quality score.
batch_policy: Every reconstruction compared to the unbatched path using the same F-number, angles and coordinates. RF rtol=1e-5/atol=1e-7; B-mode atol=1e-4 dB, rtol=0.
